verdict.rationale: Neon documents and probes confirm end-to-end agent provisioning: CLI (neon claim create, neon init, neon mcp) or REST API can create a project/database without a human account, write connection strings to .env, and the hosted MCP server (verified live via keyless probes) exposes 113 tools including project/branch creation, run_sql, migrations, and schema inspection - all without touching the dashboard. Read-only/scoped modes and API key scoping further support safe agent automation. missing for 10: independent non-vendor hands-on account of an agent completing the full create-connect-schema-query flow end-to-end.
